This page lists the capability requirements for systems that implement RWI-pharma. They complement the computable requirements in the [CapabilityStatements](#actors) and profiles, and cover behaviour that no profile can express: how Task versions work, which searches the workflow depends on, how documents and notifications are exchanged, and who may change what.

Each statement has an id that links to it, and applies to the actors listed. The table at the end lists every conformance statement in this guide and can be filtered by actor. Reading the table alone is not enough to implement the guide: it does not include the requirements expressed in profiles and CapabilityStatements, and each statement is easier to understand in its context on this page.

### Actors {#actors}

| Actor | Role | CapabilityStatement |
|---|---|---|
| [RWI-pharma Server](ActorDefinition-rwipharma-server.html) | The FHIR server, normally operated by the regulator, that holds Tasks, DocumentReferences and Binaries, hosts the SubscriptionTopics and sends notifications. | [RWI-pharma Server](CapabilityStatement-rwipharma-server.html) |
| [RWI-pharma Applicant Client](ActorDefinition-rwipharma-applicant-client.html) | The applicant's system (for example a regulatory information management system) that submits Tasks and documents, responds to Tasks assigned to the applicant, and subscribes to Task updates. | [RWI-pharma Applicant Client](CapabilityStatement-rwipharma-applicant-client.html) |
| [RWI-pharma Regulator Client](ActorDefinition-rwipharma-regulator-client.html) | The regulator's internal system that progresses Tasks on the RWI-pharma Server, adds outputs such as acknowledgments, validation reports and decisions, and creates child Tasks such as questions and invoices. | [RWI-pharma Regulator Client](CapabilityStatement-rwipharma-regulator-client.html) |
| [RWI-pharma Notification Receiver](ActorDefinition-rwipharma-notification-receiver.html) | The applicant's notification endpoint (rest-hook) that receives subscription notification Bundles from the RWI-pharma Server. It is not a FHIR server, so it has requirement statements but no CapabilityStatement. | none (not a FHIR server) |

### Task identity and versions

§cap-1^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** keep every version of a Task and **SHALL** support `vread` and instance history (`GET Task/[id]/_history`), so that every state of a Task can be retrieved.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Task Identity and Versions](rwipharmatask.html#task-identifiers); every example Task carries `meta.versionId`.</span>

§cap-2^rwipharma-server:When a Task's status, business status or outputs change, the RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** record the change as a new version of the same Task (same `Task.id`, new `meta.versionId`).§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Task Identity and Versions](rwipharmatask.html#task-identifiers)</span>

§cap-3^rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:Clients **SHALL** update the existing Task to record progress, change its status or add outputs, and **SHALL NOT** create a new Task for these purposes.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Scenario tables: Task columns show v1, v2, v3 of the same Task.</span>

§cap-4^rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:Clients **SHALL** create a new Task only for a new request (for example a question, an invoice or a labelling round) or after a terminal status, and **SHALL** link it to the related Task with `Task.basedOn` and the same `Task.groupIdentifier`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Child Tasks in Scenarios 1, 3 and 4; the resubmission in Scenario 2b.</span>

§cap-5^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support versioned updates and **SHALL** reject a Task update whose `If-Match` version is not the current version.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Requester and owner both update the same Task (scenario tables, 'Created / updated by').</span>

§cap-6^rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:Clients **SHALL** send `If-Match` with the version they last read when updating a Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: As cap-5.</span>

§cap-7^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support conditional create (`If-None-Exist`) on `Task.identifier`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Interaction Pattern](rwipharmainteractionpattern.html): the Task identifier is known before the Task id is assigned.</span>

§cap-8^rwipharma-applicant-client:The Applicant Client **SHOULD** use conditional create with the Task instance identifier when creating a Task, so that a retried request does not create a duplicate Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: As cap-7.</span>

§cap-9^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL NOT** allow Tasks to be deleted; a Task and its history are the audit trail of a regulatory procedure.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Versioning model and Provenance requirement ([Architecture](architecture.html)).</span>

### Searching

§cap-10^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support searching Tasks by `identifier`, `group-identifier`, `owner`, `requester`, `status` and `based-on`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Task identifiers, group identifiers and child Tasks used throughout the examples; [Tracking and Dashboards](usecases-status-tracking.html).</span>

§cap-11^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support the `input` search parameter defined by this guide and the core `output` search parameter, with `_include=Task:input` and `_include=Task:output`, so that a client can retrieve a Task with its documents in one request.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Every Task links its documents through `Task.input` and `Task.output`; FHIR R5 has no search parameter for `Task.input`.</span>

§cap-12^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support searching DocumentReferences by `identifier` with the `of-type` modifier, so that all versions of a document can be found by its document set identifier.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: DocumentReference document set and document version identifiers.</span>

### Documents and binaries

§cap-13^rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:Clients **SHALL** upload document content as a Binary before creating the DocumentReference that points to it, and **SHALL** reference the DocumentReference, not the Binary, from `Task.input` and `Task.output`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Post-then-Link](architecture.html#binary-upload-guide-post-then-link)</span>

§cap-14^rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:When creating a new version of a document, clients **SHALL** keep its document set identifier, assign a new document version identifier, and **SHOULD** point to the previous version with `DocumentReference.relatesTo` (`replaces`).§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [DocumentReference](rwipharmadocumentReference.html) identifier slices.</span>

§cap-15^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support transaction Bundles, so that a Binary, its DocumentReference and the Task can be submitted together.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Workflow](workflow.html) submission steps.</span>

### Notifications

§cap-16^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support topic-based Subscriptions on the Task status-change and Task-creation topics, with the `rest-hook` channel and both `id-only` and `full-resource` content.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Notifications](subscriptions.html); Subscription and SubscriptionTopic examples.</span>

§cap-17^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support every search parameter that its SubscriptionTopics use as a filter; in this guide these are Task `identifier` and Task `owner`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: SubscriptionTopic `canFilterBy` definitions.</span>

§cap-18^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** support the Subscription `$status` operation and **SHOULD** support `$events`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Notification & Status](rwipharmasubscriptionNotificationAndStatus.html)</span>

§cap-19^rwipharma-applicant-client:The Applicant Client **SHOULD** create its Task status-change Subscription, filtered by the Task identifier, when it creates the Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Interaction Pattern](rwipharmainteractionpattern.html)</span>

§cap-20^rwipharma-notification-receiver:The Notification Receiver **SHALL** accept subscription notification Bundles POSTed to its registered Endpoint address and **SHALL** respond with an HTTP 2xx status when a notification is received.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Organization & Endpoint](rwipharmaorganizationEndpoint.html)</span>

§cap-21^rwipharma-notification-receiver:The Notification Receiver **SHALL** treat a notification about a Task as an update of that Task (same `Task.id`), and **SHOULD** retrieve the current version of the Task when the notification content is `id-only`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Task Identity and Versions](rwipharmatask.html#task-identifiers)</span>

§cap-22^rwipharma-notification-receiver:The Notification Receiver **SHOULD** use notification event numbers to detect missed notifications, and **SHOULD** recover them with `$events` or by reading the Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: R5 subscription notification event numbering.</span>

§cap-30^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** send each notification as a Bundle of type `subscription-notification` whose first entry is a SubscriptionStatus that identifies the Subscription and, for event notifications, gives `eventsSinceSubscriptionStart` and each event's `eventNumber` and `focus`. The topic **SHOULD** be included for `full-resource` content and **MAY** be included for `id-only` content.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Notification & Status](rwipharmasubscriptionNotificationAndStatus.html); RWI Pharma Subscription Notification Bundle profile.</span>

§cap-31^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** send a `handshake` notification when a Subscription is activated, and **SHOULD** send `heartbeat` notifications when the Subscription specifies a `heartbeatPeriod`.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: R5 topic-based subscriptions.</span>

§cap-32^rwipharma-server:For `id-only` content, `notificationEvent.focus` **SHALL** reference the Task and the Bundle **SHALL** include an entry for the Task with `fullUrl`, `request` and `response` but no resource. For `full-resource` content, the Bundle **SHALL** include the current version of the Task. In both cases `additionalContext` **SHOULD** reference related resources, such as the parent Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Notifications](subscriptions.html); FHIR R5 SubscriptionStatus notification types and the id-only notification examples.</span>

§cap-33^rwipharma-notification-receiver:The Notification Receiver **SHALL** accept `handshake`, `heartbeat` and `event-notification` notifications with an HTTP 2xx status, **SHALL** process event notifications, and **SHOULD** ignore or reject notifications for a Subscription that its own system did not create.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: FHIR R5 SubscriptionStatus notification types; [Organization & Endpoint](rwipharmaorganizationEndpoint.html).</span>

§cap-34^rwipharma-notification-receiver:The Notification Receiver **SHOULD** verify that a `full-resource` notification comes from the RWI-pharma Server, for example using a secret supplied in the Subscription, before acting on its content.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: FHIR R5 Subscriptions, Safety and Security.</span>

### Provenance and audit

§cap-23^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** create a Provenance resource for every create or update of a Task, targeting that version of the Task.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Architecture](architecture.html): Provenance on every Task change.</span>

§cap-24^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** support searching Provenance by `target` and `_revinclude=Provenance:target` on Task searches.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: As cap-23.</span>

### Security and access

§cap-25^rwipharma-server,rwipharma-applicant-client,rwipharma-regulator-client:All interactions with the RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** be authorized using SMART Backend Services (system-level scopes, JWT bearer tokens).§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Architecture](architecture.html)</span>

§cap-26^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHALL** limit each applicant organization to the Tasks in which it is requester or owner, and to the documents linked to those Tasks.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: [Architecture](architecture.html): attribute-based access control.</span>

### Workflow responsibilities

§cap-27^rwipharma-applicant-client:The Applicant Client **SHALL** be able to create submission Tasks as requester, and **SHALL** be able to update Tasks it owns (such as question, invoice and labelling Tasks), adding its responses as outputs.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Scenario tables, 'Created / updated by'.</span>

§cap-28^rwipharma-regulator-client:The Regulator Client **SHALL** be able to update Tasks it owns, setting status and business status and adding outputs such as acknowledgments, validation reports and decisions, and **SHALL** be able to create child Tasks owned by the applicant.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: Scenario tables, 'Created / updated by'.</span>

§cap-29^rwipharma-server:The RWI-pharma Server **SHOULD** reject an update that changes a Task's `requester`, `owner`, `groupIdentifier` or Task instance identifier after the Task has been created.§

<span style="font-size:.85em;color:#555;">Basis: These values identify the parties and the procedure across all versions of a Task.</span>

### Must Support

Must Support elements are marked in each profile. For each actor, *populating* means the system can supply the element when it has the data, *processing* means it can read the element and act on it, and *storing and returning* means the server keeps the element and returns it unchanged. These statements are derived from the profiles.

### All conformance statements

§§§
